# graviteeam_application_form (Resource)

Manages a Gravitee AM Application Form (custom login, registration, and other page templates at the application level)

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "graviteeam_application_form" "example" {
  domain_id      = graviteeam_domain.example.id
  application_id = graviteeam_application.example.id
  template       = "LOGIN"
  enabled        = true
  content        = "<html><body><h1>Login</h1></body></html>"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `application_id` (String) The ID of the application this form belongs to
- `content` (String) The HTML content of the form (supports Thymeleaf expressions)
- `domain_id` (String) The ID of the domain this form belongs to
- `template` (String) The template type (e.g. LOGIN, REGISTRATION, FORGOT_PASSWORD, etc.)

### Optional

- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the custom form is enabled

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of the form
